comment: Five alternative one-knob fuzzes on the same 11 x 8 board (Colorsound 1-Knob Fuzz, Dr. Tony Balls 1966, D*A*M Meathead, Black Arts Toneworks Ritual Fuzz, D*A*M Meathead Dark) plus one bare cuts view. Only the first, the Colorsound 1-Knob Fuzz, is read here; the others differ in values.
rows: legend: Transistors are BC107/BC108, except TP2222A for Black Arts
